question: How can Sarasvatī grant the essence of enjoyment despite being waterless?
premises: Sarasvatī is acknowledged as even waterless
She is prayed to be a giver of the essence of enjoyment
Her power transcends her visible condition
inference: Even without water, Sarasvatī is prayed to grant the essence of enjoyment.
plain_english: Even though waterless, may that Sarasvatī be the giver of the essence of enjoyment.
